title: Verify Service Manager cannot void a transaction
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (this role has NO Invoicing and Payments: Delete).
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab and locate a transaction.
2. Look for a Void option; if present, click it.
expected: Voiding is BLOCKED: the Void action is hidden or disabled, or clicking it returns a permission error. Record which blocked state is shown.
